channel.title: Trump, Family & Administration — Investment Mention Tracker (Admin only)
channel.description: Every sourced stock, fund and crypto mention by Trump administration officials, with how the asset did against the S&P 500. Public data only; no wrongdoing alleged.

item.title: Commerce Dept. (CHIPS) on USA Rare Earth (USAR): Government stake/deal
item.description:
Commerce Dept. (CHIPS) (Admin) mentioned USA Rare Earth (USAR) on 2026-01-26.
Quote: $1.6B CHIPS funding LOI; government to receive 16.1M shares + warrants (8–16% stake).
Versus the S&P 500: +7.4% on the comment day, -70.8% to date.
Source: https://investors.usare.com/news-releases/news-release-details/usa-rare-earth-announces-letter-intent-us-government-access-16
Public statements and market data only; no wrongdoing is alleged. Not financial advice.
